meaning: The Temple and the Human Body
description: 1 John 2:20 says the Jews to Jesus: "For 46 years this temple has been under construction, and you will raise it up in three days?" The number 46 is thus connected with the building of the temple in Jerusalem under Herod the Great. However, Jesus uses the temple as a picture of his own body and resurrection (John 2:21), which gives the number a deeper symbolic meaning. The number 46 links together the physical temple, the human body, and Christ's resurrection, pointing to the fact that God's true temple is not built of stone but revealed in Christ.

versions.meaning: The number 46 is linked to the construction of the temple in Jerusalem, which according to the Gospel of John took 46 years to build.
versions.description: In John 2:20, the Jews say to Jesus: "It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you will raise it up in three days?" This number has been interpreted symbolically by early church fathers such as Augustine, who noted that the Greek numerical value (gematria) of the name Adam is also 46 (A=1, D=4, A=1, M=40), linking the temple to the human body and Christ's incarnation. The number has thus acquired a symbolic connection between the physical temple, the human body, and Christ's resurrection.

footnotes.text: The church father Augustine pointed out that the Greek numerical value (gematria) of the name Adam is 46 (Α=1, Δ=4, Α=1, Μ=40), and saw in this a symbolic connection between Adam, the temple, and Christ's incarnation – Christ as the new Adam dwelling in human flesh.
Herod the Great's temple project began according to Josephus around 19 BC. If the Jews' statement in John 2:20 is dated to about AD 27, the period of 46 years aligns well with this.
